'''Paploo''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Ewok]] of the [[Bright Tree tribe]] on the forest [[moon]] of [[Endor]]. During the [[Battle of Endor]], Paploo aided the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel]] strike team that was led by [[Han Solo]] in destroying the [[Death Star's shield generator|generator]] powering the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|Death Star II's]] [[deflector shield]].

==Biography==
[[File:PaploosWildRide-SWK08.png|thumb|left|250px|Paploo stole an Imperial speeder bike to create a distraction.]]
Paploo lived in [[Bright Tree Village]] on the forest [[moon]] of [[Endor]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="Episode VI" /> and was a skilled [[Ewok]] [[scout]] like his friends [[Teebo]] and [[Wicket Wystri Warrick|Wicket W. Warrick]].<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> When a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel]] strike team, led by [[Han Solo]], arrived on the moon to destroy the [[Death Star's shield generator|generator]] powering the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|Death Star II's]] [[deflector shield]], Palpoo aided the Rebels in infiltrating the generator facility.

In order to reduce the number of guards outside of the bunker's back entrance, Paploo stole a [[speeder bike]] belonging to [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[scout trooper]]s. Three of the four troopers sped after him, while only one remained behind. Though the Rebels were initially concerned that Paploo's actions would draw unwanted attention, his actions allowed the Rebels to capture the remaining stormtroopers and enter the facility. Though the Rebels were captured, they were nonetheless able to later destroy the shield generator, allowing the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]] the successful chance to destroy the [[orbit]]ing Death Star.<ref name="Episode VI" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:KennyPaploo.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Kenny Baker in his Paploo costume]]
In [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], Paploo was portrayed by [[Kenny Baker]], who also portrayed [[R2-D2]].<ref name="SWArchive credits">{{SWArchive|url=movies/episode-vi|text=''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi''}}</ref>
